title: Lovely Molten Turkish Sausages Skillet
description: A sweet and savory Turkish dish featuring molten sausages, perfect for a brunch mood, made in a traditional kazan cauldron and kosher friendly.

ingredients.name: flame liqueur
ingredients.notes: such as rum or other kosher friendly option

instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large kazan cauldron over medium heat.
Add the sliced onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the sliced bell pepper and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the diced tomato, paprika, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the Turkish sausages to the cauldron and cook for 5 minutes on each side, or until browned.
In a small bowl, mix the honey and flame liqueur.
Pour the honey and liqueur mixture over the sausages and vegetables in the cauldron.
Tilt the cauldron to ignite the liqueur and flambe the dish for 30 seconds to 1 minute.
Remove the cauldron from the heat and let it cool for a minute or two before serving.
Serve the Lovely Molten Turkish Sausages Skillet hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
